note: Two bounds in opposite directions, both checked offline and free on every PR. CORE floors catch the agent getting worse: the fixture policy is deterministic — a test asserts that — so there is no sampling noise to absorb and the floors sit exactly at the observed baseline. HARD is a ceiling, not a floor: it catches the suite getting easier. The hard tier exists because suite_agency_v1 was saturated, so a rule engine starting to pass hard cases means either that the deterministic policy genuinely improved or that the cases went soft. Those need opposite fixes, so a breach is a deliberate, reviewed re-baseline and never a silent bump.
